expected_result.paper_conclusion: GFN2-xTB/CREST covers major basins at low cost, but quantum refinement and thermochemistry can reorder conformers and materially change populations.

scoring_rubric.description: Newly generated evidence recovers the scoped paper conclusion. A conflicting ranking, phase sequence, barrier trend, selectivity, ensemble effect, or bonding interpretation is not a reproduction.
Correctly composes the required software stages, passes artifacts between them, and respects dependency, retry, and stopping logic.
Validates chemical identity, convergence, stationary-point type, wavefunction or periodic-output quality, and rejects invalid branches.
Follows the supplied paper-reconstructed protocol and clearly labels any controlled, version-compatible substitution.
Uses consistent units, reference states, normalization, statistics, and uncertainty estimates.
Links every conclusion to artifacts and separates computation, paper targets, inference, failures, and unresolved uncertainty.

critical_failures: No real conformer search was executed.
No quantum refinement or Hessian evidence was generated.
Rankings were compared without atom-mapped alignment.
Reference conformers or hidden populations were presented as newly generated.
judge_instructions: Evaluate this as a multi-software paper reproduction. Do not award conclusion credit for copied paper values, invalid intermediates, or numerically plausible results unsupported by artifacts from this run. Apply every evidence gate.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: GFN2-xTB/CREST covers major basins at low cost, but quantum refinement and thermochemistry can reorder conformers and materially change populations.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

gates.description: At least RDKit, one xTB/CREST stage, ORCA, and thermochemistry were executed.
Final conformers have valid connectivity and traceable parents.
Final population analysis handles significant imaginary modes.

unresolved_requirements: A fresh end-to-end oracle run is required to set benchmark-specific numerical tolerances for the regenerated ensemble.
